title: Although they darken the room they are heavy and wrinkle easily
text: Although they darken the room they are heavy and wrinkle easily. I wanted to like these. It’s hard to find good room darkening curtains. These definitely do the job in terms of darkening a room. However, they are extremely heavy and bulky which makes hanging them a huge pain. They are also easily wrinkled. The quality of the curtains wasn’t the greatest.
